Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. bloom-bloom:lever:a206bbd0-cd76-40f9-82e.title: Director of Brand & Social | Poppy & Peonies
bloom-bloom:lever:a206bbd0-cd76-40f9-82e.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Director of Brand & Social to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally. Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported! We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint. About the Role We are seeking a dynamic and visionary Director of Brand & Social, a creative leader with the strategic expertise and social savvy to shape how Poppy & Peonies connects with the world. This role is ideal for a marketing professional who thrives on building campaigns that resonate deeply with communities, has an impeccable eye for creative detail, and knows how to bring brand stories to life across every channel. As Director of Brand & Social, you will drive innovation across social media, influencer partnerships, email, PR, and affiliate initiatives, ensuring every touchpoint reflects our brand’s voice and vision. Leading a high-performing team and collaborating cross-functionally, you will play a pivotal role in growing and inspiring the Poppy & Peonies community through impactful storytelling and unforgettable content.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4136490b-6810-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video based in Romania. As a Senior Applied Research Engineer, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation. You will work at the intersection of generative AI research, large-scale distributed systems, and production engineering. Your work will focus on developing realistic, controllable, and expressive video generation models that can operate reliably at scale. You will own research and engineering projects end to end, translating hypotheses and experiments into measurable product impact. The role combines advanced modeling, distributed training, evaluation, inference optimization, and rigorous experimentation. You will operate in a highly technical, high-ownership environment where research is expected to move quickly toward real-world deployment. Your contributions will directly influence AI-powered video products used by businesses around the world. Develop and scale latent video diffusion models designed for human-centric video generation. Design advanced conditioning mechanisms that improve control over elements such as pose, emotion, scripts, and camera movement while maintaining high visual fidelity. Lead end-to-end applied research and engineering projects, from developing hypotheses and running experiments through to production implementation and measurable impact. Develop and optimize distributed training strategies using technologies such as DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, and sequence parallelism. Improve training stability and efficiency across large-scale, multi-GPU and multi-node environments while working within real-world compute constraints. Design robust evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics with structured human evaluation to assess model quality and performance. Optimize model inference for low latency, high resolution, scalability, and cost efficiency in production environments. Run controlled experiments, ablations, and parallel research hypotheses to identify high-value signals and guide modeling decisions. Establish and maintain strong engineering practices around reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring, and production reliability. Translate research findings into practical improvements for production-grade generative video systems. Collaborate actively with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional teams while maintaining a high degree of individual ownership. Move quickly between promising research directions, identifying low-signal approaches early and prioritizing work based on measurable outcomes. Requirements Strong professional experience training deep learning models at scale, ideally in a research or production environment. Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on expertise with PyTorch. Practical experience working with diffusion models, with image-generation experience required and video-generation experience strongly preferred. Proven experience with large-scale multi-GPU and multi-node model training. Strong understanding of distributed training frameworks and techniques such as DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, or comparable technologies. Ability to design controlled experiments, analyze noisy or ambiguous results, and make scientifically grounded modeling decisions. Experience with video diffusion models is an advantage. Experience with avatar generation, synthetic humans, or other human-centric generative AI applications is a plus. Familiarity with world models, interactive models, GANs, or VAEs is desirable. Experience optimizing inference systems for production deployment is an advantage. Strong understanding of CUDA and experience working within modern machine learning infrastructure. Ability to work effectively with technologies such as AWS, SLURM, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed training and inference systems. Research-driven

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:64ba1063-59d.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level English (AU) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level English (AU) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $55.00 USD per hour
